name: IntervenSim social-event benchmark (SNB)
description: Forty-two real 2024 online events used by the IntervenSim social-simulation track, with engagement fields and seven-point historical traffic trajectories.
provenance: The benchmark is distributed by the GA-S3 authors and reused here only as audited historical input to IntervenSim; the bundled copy is byte-identical to the project display archive.
usage_rights: Publicly distributed research benchmark; retain attribution and complete the organizer/institutional data-use review before external redistribution.
historical_features: view, like, share and comment counts
pii_assessment: Aggregate event and engagement fields only; no direct personal identifiers are used by the research planner.
redistribution_scope: Derived metrics and hashes may be submitted; redistribution of the bundled source requires the original terms and attribution review.
verification_method: Record-count and SHA-256 verification against the project display archive plus repository/source metadata review.

name: U.S. presidential election 2020 state-result snapshot
description: Fifty states plus the District of Columbia with party winner and state-level Republican/Democratic vote totals, used only by the GAS-3 U.S.-election adapter.
provenance: Read-only copy of the team's original-data election archive. The research source family is MIT Election Data and Science Lab's U.S. President 1976-2020 dataset; the normalized display snapshot is hashed independently and must be version-traced before publication.
usage_rights: Public research election returns; cite the MIT Election Data and Science Lab dataset and its Harvard Dataverse DOI, preserve version metadata, and re-check state totals against the selected release before confirmatory use.
source_version: MIT Election Lab U.S. President 1976-2020 source family; normalized 2020 state snapshot
pii_assessment: State-level aggregate certified vote totals; no voter-level personal data.
redistribution_scope: Normalized aggregate state results with MIT Election Data and Science Lab attribution and version citation.
verification_method: 51-row schema/count check, SHA-256 local fixation, and primary Harvard Dataverse DOI/source-family review.
data_lineage: MIT Election Data and Science Lab source family

name: GAS-3 state display-prior snapshot
description: Fifty states plus the District of Columbia with electoral votes and Republican/Democratic display scores used only for a bounded historical reconstruction sanity check.
provenance: Read-only copy of the team's existing election display archive; these scores are treated as target-derived display priors and never as leakage-safe prospective inputs.
usage_rights: Research-display artifact distributed with the team project; retain GAS-3 attribution and do not claim the derived scores are independently collected polls.
pii_assessment: Aggregate state-level fields only; no voter-level personal data.
redistribution_scope: Derived state display values and aggregate replay outputs with attribution; prospective-forecast claims are forbidden.
verification_method: 51-row schema/count and SHA-256 audit against the read-only frontend archive; semantic leakage warning recorded in every result.

name: STAP popularity-prediction display samples
description: Seventy-eight structured micro-video samples from the existing heat-prediction display, covering MicroLens, Informs, SMP-Video and FV-derived result records.
provenance: Read-only copy of the team's original-data heat archive. It is a derived feature/result artifact aligned with the official STAP preprocessing and evaluation contract, not a redistribution of raw videos.
usage_rights: The STAP implementation is MIT-licensed. Retain dataset-specific terms for MicroLens, Informs and SMP/FV data; publish only authorized derived features, predictions and aggregate metrics unless raw-media redistribution is separately permitted.
pii_assessment: Derived feature summaries and model/display outputs; no raw user identity is exported.
redistribution_scope: Only authorized derived features, predictions, aggregate metrics and hashes; raw media remains excluded.
verification_method: 78-row schema/count check, SHA-256 fixation, simulated-flag audit, and official STAP repository license review.

name: STAP derived popularity output panel
description: Seventy-eight derived prediction/label rows used for replay evaluation; every supplied row remains explicitly marked simulated.
provenance: Read-only copy of the team's existing heat frontend output panel, aligned to the STAP display artifact ids.
usage_rights: Derived output artifact under the project/STAP research-display contract; raw video redistribution is excluded.
pii_assessment: Derived sample-level prediction records with no exported user identity.
redistribution_scope: Derived predictions, labels, aggregate metrics and hashes only; raw videos are excluded.
verification_method: 78-row id alignment, prediction/label schema, simulated-flag and SHA-256 audit against the read-only frontend archive.
